position.description: Position the player can fill (PG, SG, SF, PF or C)
position.label: position

salary.description: Fantasy salary charged against the cap if picked
salary.label: player salary

predicted_points.description: Predicted fantasy points for the game day
predicted_points.label: predicted fantasy points

required.description: Number of players the line-up must have at this position
required.label: players required at the position

salary_cap.description: Maximum total salary of the line-up
salary_cap.label: salary cap

decision_variables.pick[player]: binary, 1 if the player is in the line-up

constraints.position[player]: sum of pick over players with this player's position == required[position] (one row per player, as in the original)
